title: The Progression of Blood (4): Passover — one substitute covers a household
summary: Fourth step in “The Progression of Blood”: Passover, where one substitute sacrifice covers an entire household. Exodus 12:3 is quoted, with “lamb” highlighted in red: a lamb for each household.

text.text: One Substitute Sacrifice Covers Entire Household
3 “Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth of this month they are each one to take a lamb for themselves, according to their fathers’ households, a lamb for each household.
